title: Casa al Fin Vacation Rental
meta_description: Casa al Fin is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionCASA AL FINRosemary Beach CommunityNorth Spanish Town Lane, Rosemary Beach, FL 32461Home Highlights4 bedrooms (see room configurations in “Room Details” tab)4 full baths, 1 half bathSleeps 8 guests3,100 sq. ft. interior | 2,850 sq. ft. outdoor living spaceLess than a minute walk to the beach; across the street from community poolMultiple balconies and porches, including a large second-floor wraparound balconyPrivate walled-in courtyard with planter benches and cozy sitting areasCarriage-style outdoor lounge with comfortable furnishings and café lightsChef’s kitchen with dual sinks, double ovens, 6-burner stove, and dual drawer dishwashersLaundry room with washer & dryer on the first floorOutdoor showerOne-car garage + 1 vehicle overflow (1 community parking pass issued) (Left side of garage owner has car stored)Four 26" adult bikes included seasonally (not available Dec–Feb; additional rentals upon request)About the HomeCasa Al Fin, meaning “Home At Last,” is a masterfully crafted retreat combining luxurious design with a prime Rosemary Beach location. Enjoy the all-white stone patio with an architectural stucco fireplace, a second-level gazebo with privacy shutters, or the towering Tuscan-style ceilings in the great room.The open, airy second-floor living area features a gourmet kitchen with a large island and bench seating for family gatherings. Six sets of French doors open to wraparound balconies, including a private gazebo above the two-car garage. Each bedroom has a private bath with custom mosaic tilework. Three bedrooms are on the first floor, while the king guest master on the third floor boasts a private balcony with partial Gulf views.Community AmenitiesRosemary Beach offers a luxurious coastal experience with charming streets, boutique shopping, and renowned dining:4 community pools (some heated seasonally)Private community beach accessRosemary Town Square with shops and diningPlayground, parks, and green spacesOutdoor amphitheaterPedestrian paths and lush landscapingFitness center and racquet club (additional fee)Note: Golf carts are prohibited in the Rosemary community.ParkingCasa Al Fin provides 1 designated garage spaces. Only 1 community parking pass is issued per HOA rules. On-street parking is first-come, first-served, and must be in lined spaces with a valid permit. The HOA strictly enforces all parking regulations.Reservation & Booking PolicyNO SMOKINGPets not allowed (service animals only; documentation required)Published rates do not include taxes and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior (or full payment if within 60 days)Initial 50% is fully refundable for cancellations >60 days prior (5% cancellation fee applies)Optional travel insurance available if purchased before final paymentCheck-in: 4:00 PM (CST) | Check-out: 10:00 AMGuest must be at least 25 years oldCancellation policies and terms in the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement override third-party sites. Service fees from third-party bookings are non-refundable.
